Capricorn — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11.

Both arms as blades — the technique that cuts twice in the space of one cut.

Make two unarmed Strikes against a single creature within reach. Both are made at your full attack modifier with no multiple attack penalty, both gain deadly d12, and both ignore Hardness, resistance, and immunity to physical damage.

If both hit, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure it is severed, as The Sharpest Sword.

The activity counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty afterward.

Heightening (+2 levels) Each Strike deals an additional 1d8 slashing damage.

On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.

Automation note: this Technique's bonus damage starts at zero and is purely a heightening rider, which pf2e cannot express as a damage entry — a spell needs a base formula to scale from. Add 1d8 slashing per heightening step to each Strike by hand: one step at 13th, two at 15th, and so on, plus 2 more on an Ascendant day or 4 on a Zenith.
